imu_frame.note: levelled body frame: after the legs-neutral stance settles, rotate the phone's readings by the smallest rotation that makes the gravity it measures read +z (so x stays toward the nose, y to the robot's left); accel is accelerationIncludingGravity in m/s^2, gyro in rad/s; IMU_SIGN must be [1, 1, 1] for this policy

cmd_yaw.sign: positive when the target is counter-clockwise of the robot's nose seen from above, i.e. turn left

cmd_forward.scale: +1 walks toward the target at 3 cm/s, 0 stands still and keeps turning to face it, below 0 backs away (trained down to the range's low end)
